Vendored psd_sdk — provenance & maintenance
===========================================

`Psd/` is a source copy of the psd_sdk library, compiled from source by this
crate's build.rs (`cc`) together with the C-ABI wrapper in `../src/wrapper.cpp`.
This is the same model the workspace already uses for ufbx (`crates/import`) and
meshoptimizer + ufbx_write (`crates/optimize`): vendored source, no prebuilt
binary, no bindgen or libclang at build time — so a clean checkout builds on any
OS that has a C++ compiler.

Underlying library
------------------
psd_sdk by Molecular Matters GmbH — https://github.com/MolecularMatters/psd_sdk
Vendored commit: f51449543273cbf12058ae92b230e0c4209f5066
License: BSD 2-Clause (see LICENSE).
Only src/Psd/ (the library) is vendored; Samples/bin/build are omitted.

Patched, not an unmodified snapshot: `review.patch` is the diff of `Psd/` against
the commit above, and every hunk is marked `review-psd patch` in the source.

  P1  PsdDecompressRle.cpp/.h - every run is bounds-checked against the
      destination and the source; a malformed stream returns false instead of
      writing past the plane or reading past the RLE buffer.
  P2  PsdParseImageDataSection.cpp - plane sizes in 64-bit arithmetic (refused
      past 32 bits), every allocation null-checked, the RLE payload bounded by
      the image data section it sits in, channel count < 256 refused rather than
      asserted, and a failed decode frees what it allocated and returns nullptr.

Header validation (bit depth, colour mode, channel count, size caps) is not a
patch: it lives in ../src/wrapper.cpp, which also no longer calls the image
resources parser (its DISPLAY_INFO branch assumes RGB and writes through NULL
for a grayscale document with alpha).

What is compiled
----------------
Every `Psd/*.cpp` except the platform `NativeFile` sources, plus
`../src/wrapper.cpp`. `PsdNativeFile_Linux.cpp` is POSIX aio and
`PsdNativeFile_Mac.mm` is Objective-C++ (never picked up — not a `.cpp`);
`PsdNativeFile.cpp` is the Win32 `CreateFileW` + overlapped-IO one and is
excluded off Windows. None of the three is reachable: `wrapper.cpp` reads
through its own in-memory `psd::File`, so no `NativeFile` is ever instantiated.

The C ABI and the committed bindings
------------------------------------
`../src/wrapper.h` declares the C ABI (`fire_psd_open` / `_info_get` /
`_decode_merged` / `_read_merged_rgba8` / `_free`); `../src/bindings.rs`
is a committed Rust mirror of it, originally bindgen output. Nothing regenerates
it during a build — the two are kept in lockstep by hand, and the size/offset
assertions in `bindings.rs` are what turn a mismatch into a compile error. If you
change the ABI, change both, and `../src/lib.rs` with them.

To regenerate `bindings.rs` after an ABI change, run bindgen over `wrapper.h`
(it includes only <stdint.h> / <stddef.h> so no STL headers are parsed):

  bindgen crates/psd/src/wrapper.h -o crates/psd/src/bindings.rs \
    --allowlist-function 'fire_psd_.*' --allowlist-type 'fire_psd.*' \
    -- -x c++ -std=c++17

Updating psd_sdk
----------------
Replace `Psd/` with the new upstream `src/Psd/`, update the commit above,
re-apply `review.patch` (`git apply --directory=crates/psd/vendor
crates/psd/vendor/review.patch`, resolving drift by hand), regenerate the patch
from the result, and rebuild. `tests/synthetic.rs` exercises every patched path. `wrapper.cpp` uses only psd_sdk's public parse/destroy API plus
`psd::Document` / `psd::PlanarImage` / `psd::ImageDataSection` fields.
